name: Cyprian Keyes Golf Club
architects: Mark Mungeam of Cornish, Silva & Mungeam (opened 11 August 1997; Wikipedia, golflink.com)

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM, project MA_CentralEastern_2021_B21 (2021 USGS Lidar: Central Eastern Massachusetts), tile x27y470 (published 2023-01-15), clipped to the world + 100 m by pipeline/intake.py raster; NAD83 / UTM 19N, NAVD88 metres; fetched by the GitHub Actions fetch workflow 2026-10-31 (release data-cyprian_keyes)

world.note: OSM course boundary (way 309568600, both the Championship 18 and the 9-hole par-3 course) bbox 1,063 x 1,541 m in UTM 19N + scenery, whole 256 m chunks, centred: 1,536 m east-west (236 m each side), 1,792 m north-south (125 m each side)

scorecard_source: The club's printed Championship card (cypriankeyes.com/images/documents/Championship-18-hole-Scorecard.jpg, linked from the club's Scorecards page; fetched by the GitHub Actions fetch workflow 2026-10-31, release data-cyprian_keyes): Blue 6,543 (72.7/139), White 6,098 (men 71.0/129), Green 5,595 (men 68.9/120), Gold 4,850 (69.5/123); every row adds up to its printed total; men's handicap row used. Blue is the club's back tee, so Blue and White are built (developer's overnight call: Blue and the next set forward). Conflict: GolfLink, GolfPass and OpenGolfAPI list a different, longer set (Black 6,871 74.4/136, Blue 6,498, White 6,134, Green 5,676, Gold 5,029, other stroke indexes); not on the club's card, not built (open item).
attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (2021 Central Eastern Massachusetts lidar)
red_water_note: Seven waters inside the boundary mapped only as natural=water or natural=wetland (open wet meadows and a marsh, and three ponds by the clubhouse between 1, 18 and the par-3 course): red penalty areas (standing default, COURSE_BUILD 4.1); otherwise they would play as rough. The wooded swamp along Sewall Brook between 3/4/14 and 5/10 (w86095496, MassGIS 'wooded swamp deciduous') stays woods, with its trees (Pumpkin Ridge / Highland precedent); the brook through it is a red channel.

laz.source: 2021 USGS Lidar: Central Eastern Massachusetts (3DEP project MA_CentralEastern_2021_B21), tiles 19TBG274690, 276690, 274689, 276689 (published 2022-10-13), clipped to the world + 100 m with pipeline/intake.py laz (classes 3-5); NAD83(2011) / UTM 19N, NAVD88 (Geoid18) metres; flown spring 2021, leaf-off; fetched by the GitHub Actions fetch workflow 2026-10-31 (release data-cyprian_keyes)
